Package neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger

Class CoolantBoilingMargin

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.heatexchanger.CoolantBoilingMargin
public final class CoolantBoilingMargin extends Object
Coolant boiling-margin helper for gas coolers and heat exchangers.

On a tempered-water / cooling-medium loop the coolant must stay sub-cooled (above its boiling pressure) relative to the hottest surface it contacts, i.e. the hot process-side inlet temperature. This helper computes the coolant saturation temperature at a given coolant pressure and the resulting sub-cooling margin against a hot-side temperature, and flags a boiling risk. It is a screening aid: it evaluates a thermodynamic bubble-point on a clone of the supplied coolant fluid and never modifies the caller's fluid.

1.0
Author:

    • evaluate

      public static CoolantBoilingMargin.Result evaluate(SystemInterface coolant, double coolantPressureBara, double hotSideTemperatureC, double minimumMarginC)
      Evaluate the coolant boiling margin at a given coolant pressure against a hot-side temperature.

      The supplied coolant fluid is cloned; its pressure is set to coolantPressureBara and a bubble-point temperature flash gives the coolant saturation temperature. The sub-cooling margin is the saturation temperature minus the hot-side temperature. If the bubble-point flash does not converge the saturation temperature (and margin) are Double.NaN.

      Parameters:
      coolant - coolant fluid (e.g. water / tempered cooling medium); not modified
      coolantPressureBara - coolant pressure to evaluate [bara]; must be positive
      hotSideTemperatureC - hot process-side contact temperature [C]
      minimumMarginC - minimum acceptable sub-cooling margin [C]; used for the withinMargin flag
      Returns:
      the boiling-margin result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if coolant is null or the pressure is not positive
